name: Simple setup and observable companion recovery
statement: Offer a short explicit native setup flow and inspectable secret-free connection-stage diagnostics so normal use is automatic and failures are actionable.
requiredProperties: home and other folder choices without implied grants
bounded stage/code reports accessible when main UI fails
authenticated debug API without credential/path/content disclosure
distinguish manual mode from remembered automatic native mode

provenance.sourceReference: Owner 2026-10-15: automatic ID/home/other-folder setup and stage-by-stage debug UI/API after unexplained offline failures
